tokens.name: bg-void
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: title bar, navigation rail, status bar, terminal wells. The frame the work sits inside.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Application background behind every working panel.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Elevated panels: inspector, graph nodes, cards that hold one object, popovers.

tokens.name: bg-surface-2
tokens.usage: Secondary surface: input wells, selected rows, panel headers that need separation from bg-surface.

tokens.name: bg-surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill on bg-surface and bg-surface-2 controls.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Command palette, dialogs and menus — always paired with shadow-overlay.

tokens.name: line-hair
tokens.usage: The default 1px hairline: panel boundaries, table rules, control borders.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Inner separators inside one panel (rows of a list, sections of the inspector).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders on hover, splitter handles while dragging, the outline of a focused panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and active icons on every bg-* token (≥13:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, inactive tabs, timestamps beside primary text. ≥5.9:1 on bg-surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: metadata, column headers, section labels. ≥4.5:1 on bg-void, bg-canvas and bg-surface; use ink-muted on bg-surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text only: disabled glyphs, graph grid marks, placeholder rules, connector lines. Fails 4.5:1 — never for words a reader needs.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Spectral periwinkle. The one signature hue: selection, focus, the primary action, live delegation edges, the active nav item. Rare by rule — at most one filled accent control per view. 6.9:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: accent-hi
tokens.usage: Accent text on accent-wash, focus rings, hover state of accent controls.

tokens.name: accent-lo
tokens.usage: Pressed accent fill and the accent graph-edge core. Not for text.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected row, accent chips. Text on it is accent-hi or ink.

tokens.name: accent-line
tokens.usage: Border of a selected node or panel; the dashed delegation edge at rest.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary button). 6.9:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Luminous emerald — only for VERIFIED outcomes: a passing test, a health check that returned 200, a verified milestone. Never for 'command exited'. Always paired with a check glyph or the word.

tokens.name: success-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a verified row or the emerald confirmation flash.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Sophisticated amber: blocked, waiting on a person, degraded, warnings in a report. Paired with a clock or triangle glyph.

tokens.name: warning-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a blocked node, a warning row, a pending approval stripe.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Restrained coral — genuine failure only: a failing test, a crashed process, a destructive action's confirm button. Paired with an x glyph or the word. 7.6:1 on bg-canvas.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a failing row, the diagnostic panel of a failed agent.

tokens.name: human
tokens.usage: Warm bone. Marks things a PERSON owns or controls: human terminal sessions, takeover state, your comments. Distinguishes human from agent without a second hue.

tokens.name: diff-add
tokens.usage: Background of an added line in a diff.

tokens.name: diff-add-strong
tokens.usage: Intra-line added range; the gutter marker of an added line.

tokens.name: diff-del
tokens.usage: Background of a removed line in a diff.

tokens.name: diff-del-strong
tokens.usage: Intra-line removed range; the gutter marker of a removed line.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Code: keywords, control flow.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: Code: strings and template literals.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Code: numbers, booleans, null.

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Code: types, classes, built-ins.

tokens.name: syn-fn
tokens.usage: Code: function and method names.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Code: comments. 4.1:1 on bg-void — comments are secondary by convention.

tokens.name: syn-attr
tokens.usage: Code: properties, attributes, object keys.

tokens.name: term-red
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI red.

tokens.name: term-green
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI green.

tokens.name: term-yellow
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI yellow.

tokens.name: term-blue
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI blue.

tokens.name: term-cyan
tokens.usage: Terminal ANSI cyan, paths and URLs in output.

families.mono: "DejaVu Sans Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: First launch only. One per screen.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Mission titles and the title of a report. Never inside a panel.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Page and object titles: an agent's name in its detail view, a dialog title.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Rotate refresh tokens on every use and revoke the family on reuse.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Session middleware now validates the token family before issuing.
styles.usage: Default interface text: rows, messages, inspector values.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, button labels, the subject of an event.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Updated 2 minutes ago by Security Engineer
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a row title, tooltips, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels in uppercase, ink-subtle. Purposeful: a label names the data below it or it is cut.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Timestamps, hashes, paths, IDs inline with interface text. Tabular by nature.

styles.name: mono-label
styles.usage: Identifiers set as labels: mission IDs, role marks, keyboard hints.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-count gap inside a chip; stacked hairlines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The base unit. Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and keyboard hints.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; padding of compact rows.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of panel headers, rows and inputs.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Padding inside the inspector and dialogs; gap between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gutter of the main canvas content.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Space between major groups within one screen.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Padding of full-screen empty states and reports.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: First-launch composition margins only.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, keyboard hints, role marks, diff ranges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, graph nodes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, toasts, inline approval cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Command palette and dialogs — the largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Buttons and graph nodes: a lit top edge, not a drop shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips, toasts, hover cards.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Command palette and dialogs.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Integrated title bar and command region height.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Collapsed navigation rail width.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Expanded contextual sidebar width.

tokens.name: size-inspector
tokens.usage: Default context inspector width (resizable 280–420).

tokens.name: size-statusbar
tokens.usage: Status bar height.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, tabs and list rows.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact controls inside panel headers and table rows.

tokens.name: size-panel-header
tokens.usage: Height of every panel header.
